_readme: Witch tuning. Edit the numbers, push, and the playable link rebuilds. Distances are metres, times seconds, angles degrees. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_map: The forest: 20 x 20 areas cut by the fractal partition; borderLayers sets how wiggly borders are.
_trees: treeDensity (0-1): the chance of a tree on each spot outside the clearings; clearingSize (0-1): how large the open middle of each area is; clearingEdge: how gradually trees thin toward it (small is a sharp edge); trees sit on a staggered grid treeSpacingX by treeSpacingZ metres, so no two crowns pile up. A tree is left out where its crown (crownHalfWidth either side, crownHeight up) would hang over a clearing seen from the treetops.
_witch: Speeds per mode, and how long rising and descending take.
_camera: Near-isometric, after Transistor: a narrow field of view (fov, degrees) seen from far off, so there is little perspective. Each mode has its own angle (degrees below horizontal) and distance from the witch, at zoomed-in and zoomed-out. Zoom moves between them in zoomSteps steps.
_look: pixelSize: screen pixels per art pixel. glowReach: metres the witch's light reaches. spriteTilt: 1 = sprites face the camera fully, 0 = stand upright.
_post: bloom: a gentle glow round bright things (strength 0 or on false turns it off; threshold: how bright a pixel must be to glow). tiltShift: blurs the top and bottom of the screen so the forest looks like a miniature. strength: the blur at the screen's edges, in pixels; band: the height of the sharp band (0-1 of the screen); centre: where it sits (0 top, 0.5 middle, 1 bottom); where: 'before' blurs at the low resolution, before the pixels are scaled up, 'after' blurs the scaled-up image. Add ?tilt=before, ?tilt=after or ?tilt=off to the link to compare.
_creatures: Creatures grow more numerous and older with an area's distance from home (0 at the dancefloor, 1 at the map's edge): creaturesNear in the areas round home, creaturesFar at the edge (creatureCurve shapes the rise), youngShareFar of them young at the edge, and legendsFar legends from legendsFrom outward. Only creatures within creatureSimRadius metres of the witch move.
_setPieces: setPieceChance: the share of areas, among the types that have a set piece, that show theirs.
